ctx.x: Old Joe Blades. All my... I'd have to... If you had briefed me on that, I could give you a list of about 30 or 40 popular numbers. Rambling Blues, Toddling Blues, and Some Rainy Night.
Mm-hmm. Now, where did you get the inspiration for a lot of these things?
